summary.title: Summary
summary.content: Software Engineer with experience building and leading teams, working with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C++ and their respective frameworks. I have hands-on experience working in various sectors: Web, Banking, AI and ML with good exposure to the industry best practices and standards across the entire Software Development Life Cycle. I strive to ensure the best approach to software development. **My Philosophy is that whatever can be made simple should not be made unnecessarily complex.**

items.description:
• Joined the team to help rebuild the V2 of the product from scratch with a focus of rewriting the backend, converting it from PHP to NestJs.

  • Built and completed the Auth and 2 other modules making a total of 3 out of the 9 modules in 30 days.

  • Ensured best industry practice on the auth module, following all best auth practices like access control, token management, refresh, rotation, and more.

  • Worked closely with the mobile team to ensure that all provided APIs work align with the UI design flow. I leveraged my knowledge of frontend development which made collaboration with the mobile team seamless.

  • Made upgrades to the V1 backend architectural flow to accommodate the new v2 features such as the backend-blockchain integration sync and wallet features and to ensure the product scale.

  • In 3 months, 6 out of the 9 modules have been implemented and fully functional.

  • We successfully made the first release 5 months into the project. Successfully migrating users to the new V2, and ensuring scale for new users.

  • Built the internal dashboard for Visualizing and managing user's data and for system-wide configuration that affects the backend, mobile and our server deployments.

  • Led the implementation of the new gamified lesson module of the project to ensure a fun environment with minimal overhead and proprt state management both from the client and the server-side of the app, for a rich-experience for the user.

  • I Leverage the use of AI to ensure faster release of our product's implementation.

  • I Wrote all Unit and Integration tests for the auth module and the gamified lesson module.

  • Led the implementation of the Gamified Challenge module of the project, ensuring that our users can compete with other users which also improve knowledge retention.

• I joined Navis War Game, a startup dedicated to developing a battleship game on the blockchain, in August 2024.

  • Actively participated in the development process, contributing significantly to the beta launch of the game in October 2024.

  • Refactored the game logic to enable bot-player interactions and gameplay functionality.

  • Created and implemented new UI screens to align with the game's design requirements and enhance user experience.

  • Collaborated with backend developers to monitor, display, and store game statistics, ensuring seamless integration of frontend and backend systems.

  • Implemented dynamic ship formations for both computer and player components, enhancing gameplay variety.

  • Refactored the game turn system and introduced a turn countdown feature for improved user engagement and information clarity.

  • Enhanced user experience by enabling the saving and loading of ship formations from storage, facilitating user customization and reusability.

  • Implemented ship color changes to visually indicate hits and misses during gameplay interactions.

  • Resolved critical issues, including fixing computer ship overflow during formation and addressing inconsistencies in bot gameplay behaviour.

  • Spearheading the development of the NFT marketplace within the game, allowing users to discover, purchase, own, and trade game-specific NFTs.

  • Played a pivotal role in the successful beta release of the game in October 2024, showcased by the game's significant growth to over 40,000 monthly users and more than 27,000 active players.

  • Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to optimizing user experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Continuously sought opportunities to innovate, collaborate, and improve frontend development practices to drive project success and user satisfaction.

• I refactored the frontend game logic to enable bot-player interactions and gameplay functionality.

  • I implemented new game UI screens to align with the game's design requirements and enhance user experience aligning with game optimizations.

  • Collaborated with the backend developers to monitor, display, and store real-time gameplay data and statistics, ensuring seamless integration of frontend and backend systems.

  • I co-implemented the dynamic ship formations for the ai and player components, enhancing gameplay variety.

  • I refactored the game turn system and introduced a turn countdown feature for improved user engagement and information clarity.

• Contributing member of the Scooper Labs team, actively involved in the development of AssetScooper, a token aggregator platform designed to consolidate various tokens into a single token equivalent, enhancing user convenience and efficiency.

  • Collaborating closely with the lead frontend developer since September 2024, focusing on integrating smart contracts and frontend functionalities to optimize user experience.

  • Implemented key features, including a trend system that provides users with real-time insights on token value trends over the past hour, enabling informed decision-making.

  • Engaged in multiple code reviews and collaborated on the revamp of token fetching and display mechanisms to streamline the token aggregation process.

  • Co-created the BlockRepo's website, a related product of Scooper Labs, aligning the website's development with design specifications to ensure a cohesive branding experience.

  • Instrumental in the alpha release of the project, showcasing dedication to delivering high-quality frontend solutions and garnering recognition from base ecosystem's founder Jesse and other key stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in frontend development, smart contract integration, and collaborative problem-solving within a dynamic team environment.

  • Committed to innovation, user-centric design, and contributing to the success and growth of projects within the blockchain ecosystem.

  • Played a pivotal role in advancing user experience and technical capabilities within the token aggregation space, positioning Scooper Labs as a leader in the industry.

• I contributed to the frontend development of AssetScooper, a blockchain token aggregator platform designed to combine various tokens into a single token equivalent, prevent dangling user funds.

  • I collaborated closely with the lead frontend developer from September 2024, focusing on integrating the DeFi smart contracts and frontend functionalities to optimize user experience.

  • I implemented key features, including a trend system that provides users with real-time insights on token value trends over timeline, enabling informed decision-making.

  • I participated in multiple code reviews and collaborated on the revamp of token fetching and display mechanisms to streamline the token aggregation process.

• In January 2024, I mentored 70 students from the tenth web3bridge cohort on web3 basics. 

  • In April 2024, I represented Web3bridge at the University of Cape Verde, discussing Blockchain security. 

  • I presented at the Starknet Africa conference in May 2024, focusing on L2 solutions for scaling Ethereum. 

  • I have been leading students' operations at web3bridge since January 2024.

• Built, deployed and integrated various on-chain decentralized applications (dApps) both on L1 and L2 chains.

  • Designed, implemented and integrated smart-contracts for 4 dapps using frontend SDKs such as thirdweb, wagmi and rainbowkit.

  • Collaborated with 4 other web3 developers to develop a functional eco-incentive platform deployed on Base blockchain called wastewise in November 2023.

  • Authored various smart contracts using Solidity ensuring security and efficiency through test driven development and modern approaches to smart contract development.

  • Gained practical experience developing various smart contracts using hardhat and foundry.

  • Participated in one of Nigeria's biggest Web3 CTF in August 2023 and my team almost won the grand price.

  • Participated and won two hackathons including web3bridge's cohort IX hackathon built on Base and Near BOS Blockchain hackathon where my team came first in the gold challenge in November 2023.

  • Got to the last stage interview of Starknet LambdaClass in December 2023.

• Worked with a leading commercial bank in Nigeria, to develop its retail banking platform (Banking as a Service) aimed at a 20% increase in response time and 40% increase in User Experience.

  • Built RESTful APIs that served two of the microservices that will power the banking software which will handle millions of requests

  • Led and mentored a team of 4 developers to build a Microsoft sponsored IoT project that promotes computer-based education in rural school without access to internet

  • Implemented SonarQube to maintain 100% code quality across the microservices.

  • Held code review sessions every 2 days to ensure code quality of the codebase which helped reduced the software development feedback cycle by 40%.

• Contributed to the re-architect from a multi-page web app to a single page web-app which led to a 40% increase in user experience.

  • Implemented the logic to Integrate real-time functionality to the SPA using websockets protocol to automate notifications, increasing notification response time by 80%.

  • Refactored the application logic to use caching at the DB level reducing the number of times needed to hit the database which improved page load speed by 30%.

  • Contributed to refactoring the django templates to use custom django filters for server-side calls, which reduced the number of Ajax calls which in turn increased page load speed by 35%.

  • Developed a custom CSS library (EyeCSS) similar to tailwind CSS written in Python for ease-of-use with the Django templates which reduced design time by 40%.

- Used a third-party ML model to provide the summarization.

- Implemented offline functionality.
- Fully responsive.
- Light / Dark themes.
